execution.criterion: every image of the phase committed after its per-image audit passed, for this freeze

gate2_prefetch_off_equals_impress.criterion: prefetch off: generated tokens, per-layer used sets, read bytes and read call counts equal the IMPRESS arm executed in the same session, every request

gate3_output_equals_impress.criterion: prefetch on: generated tokens and per-layer used sets equal IMPRESS, every request

gate5_unread_rows_not_used.criterion: every visual row of the prefix cache holds NaN before the first layer; rows are overwritten only by reads; at masked columns the debug wrapper passes 0 (what an unread row holds in a normal request), nowhere else: the attention output of every layer is finite, the unmasked visual columns equal the layer's used set G_l, every used row was read, and tokens and used sets equal IMPRESS

gate6_sync_equals_async.criterion: prefetch executed on the request thread: generated tokens equal the asynchronous arm, every request

gate6_repeat.criterion: the same request executed a second time: generated tokens equal, every request
